name: Fate's Hand — Feats (EN)

attribution.text: Original Fate's Hand content: all rights reserved. This layer adds a record of its own and modifies NO material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 — it patches no SRD feat and disables none.

description: The Fate's Hand feats that carry a Destiny value or a skill pool bonus. Auspicious (fh) grants +2 to the Destiny Score; Skilled is patched to grant +6 skill points, at parity with its SRD text.

data.name: Auspicious (fh)
data.description: +2 Destiny · fate leans toward you (replaces Lucky)

srd:feat:en:skilled.note: Fate's Hand — Skilled grants 6 skill points (3 proficiencies × tier_costs.proficient of 2), at exact parity with its SRD text of three skills or tools of the player's choice. It imposes nothing: the points are the player's to spend.
